label: Kpower
description: Adds a virtual power meter to your Karoo, estimating power from a physics model when you don't have a real power meter.
releaseNotes: Major update: the power estimation has been reworked, so your power numbers will change noticeably. Your existing profiles are kept and keep working - just review them after updating. Changes: 3-second power smoothing and slope filtering remove watt spikes; the FTP-scaled cap uses realistic peak-over-FTP margins (1.2xFTP+130W); cadence gating has hysteresis; tailwind handling is fixed; and rolling resistance can adjust by surface from offline maps.
